description: This file defines the FooTable.DateColumn class, a custom column type for handling date values in FooTable. It depends on moment.js for date parsing and formatting, and registers the 'date' column type.

classes.name: F.DateColumn
classes.description: A class extending FooTable.Column to handle date values with parsing, formatting, and filtering capabilities, dependent on moment.js.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the date column with a specified format string, defaulting to 'MM-DD-YYYY'.

methods.name: parser
methods.description: Parses a cell value or element into a moment.js object, handling various data types.

methods.name: formatter
methods.description: Formats a moment.js object into a string for display in the table cell.

methods.name: filterValue
methods.description: Converts a cell value or element into a string suitable for filtering, formatting dates as needed.
